question: In which year did the Indian Badminton team create history by winning the Thomas Cup tournament?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2022**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Indian Badminton Team** created history in **2022** by winning the prestigious **Thomas Cup** for the first time since the tournament's inception in **1949**.
 
• This victory marked a significant milestone in Indian badminton, showcasing the country's emergence as a strong contender on the global stage.
 
• The **Thomas Cup** is an international badminton tournament conducted by the **Badminton World Federation (BWF)**, often referred to as the "World Men's Team Championships."
 
• The Indian team defeated the **14-time champions, Indonesia**, in the finals with a decisive score of **3-0**.
 
• Key players like **Lakshya Sen**, the doubles pair of **Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty**, and **Kidambi Srikanth** delivered stellar performances in the final match.
 
• This victory was celebrated as a monumental achievement in Indian sports, as it demonstrated the growing strength and depth of Indian badminton talent.
 
• The tournament was held in **Bangkok, Thailand**, in 2022.
